input.quote: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: The core Services and paid-up licence grants are strong: § 13.1 (p0048) extends access to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors; § 13.2 (p0049) gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence to delivered/embedded Vendor Technology for Customer and its Affiliates; and § 13.3 (p0050) permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation/suspension to uncured material breach after notice and cure. Those meet the preferred position. The Deliverable licence in § 14.2 (p0054), however, is expressly "revocable, non-transferable" and expires with the Order Form term, with no path to cover Affiliates or contractors — a revocable-at-Vendor's-discretion grant that sits in walk-away territory and conflicts with §§ 13.3 and 10.1. Deliverable ownership itself is left to the IP rule; this finding addresses only the licence scope. Redline makes the Deliverable licence perpetual and irrevocable, extends it to Affiliates and contractors, and permits successor transfer via § 13.3.

proposal.summary: Make the Deliverable licence perpetual and irrevocable, extend it to Affiliates and contractors, and allow transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a Deliverable licence that Vendor may revoke at will and that lapses at the end of the Order Form term, particularly for work product we paid to have created; this also conflicts with Sections 13.3 and 10.1. We have made the licence perpetual and irrevocable and extended it to our Affiliates and contractors, with transfer permitted to a successor under Section 13.3.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify, and create derivative works from each Deliverable for their business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3.
